a.lede: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.
a.title: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’

b.lede: The FAA grounded flights for hours on November 13, and the transportation secretary blamed it on old and malfunctioning air traffic control system.
b.title: FAA allows flights to resume after hours-long ground stop across the US
